name: T01 cancel: the key is handed to clearTimeout
why: the timer of a cancelled or replaced run is never cleared (a real timer would still fire)

name: T02 dispose: the KEYS are cleared as handles
why: disposed pending timers are not cleared

name: T03 the entry is deleted after the run, in a finally
why: a run that schedules its own key leaves a timer the table no longer knows (cancel and dispose cannot reach it): the dropped second run still runs, a disposed debouncer still runs it, and the timer that is running is cleared a second time; killed by the four 'a run that schedules its own key ...' rows of typing-debounce.test.ts (the throwing-run row passes under it)

name: T04 the entry is deleted after a run that did not throw
why: the entry is deleted after a run that did not throw: the same four rows fail, and the throwing-run row too (a throwing run leaves a stale entry, so a later cancel and dispose clear a timer that has run: seen by the fake clock's stale-clear counter only); killed by those five rows of typing-debounce.test.ts

name: T05 the scheduler keeps the last snapshot when no editor is active
why: after the active editor goes away the next event with an editor compares with a snapshot of the editor before, and is evaluated at once instead of debounced; EQUIVALENT in the host (an active-editor change always evaluates at once, before any changed()), so the kill is of the module's own docstring clause 'undefined: none yet, or no editor was active'; killed by the row '(the module's contract, not reachable in the host) ...' of s342-typing-path-rows.test.ts

name: T06 normalizeDelayMs: NaN is kept
why: NaN reaches the timer

name: T07 the default report drops the error
from: console.error("Quarto: a debounced typing-path run failed", error);
to: console.error("Quarto: a debounced typing-path run failed");
why: the cause of a failed run is lost

name: T08 the scheduler's debounced run is evaluated twice
why: the scan runs twice per pause

name: T09 an edit event also marks the version as evaluated
why: the cursor event that follows an edit is evaluated at once, not debounced

name: E01 updateCellContext: the key follows the selection's anchor
why: a selection made backwards sets the key from its far end; the value is not observable in the host (VS Code offers no read back of a context key); killed by s342-typing-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'the ACTIVE end of the selection')

name: E02 isInCodeCell: the key is true OUTSIDE a cell
from: findCellAtPosition(typeof text === "function" ? text() : text, line) !== null
to: findCellAtPosition(typeof text === "function" ? text() : text, line) === null
why: ctrl+enter binds in prose and not in a cell; the predicate was inline in updateCellContext when the lens wrote this (a GAP: nothing read the value), it is core's isInCodeCell now; killed by every row of in-code-cell.test.ts that reads a line

name: E03 isInCodeCell: only a markdown document
why: the key is never true in a .qmd; killed by every quarto row of in-code-cell.test.ts

name: E04 updateCellContext: the key is set to the negation of the answer
why: ctrl+enter binds in prose and not in a cell; killed by s342-typing-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'does not call setContextKey(IN_CELL_CONTEXT, inCell)')

name: E05 activeDocumentSnapshot: no document is a snapshot
why: no editor looks like an editor with an empty key: the scheduler never takes the no-editor path

name: E06 updateCellContext: the language id handed to isInCodeCell is a literal markdown
why: the key is never true in a .qmd; killed by s342-typing-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'does not hand isInCodeCell `editor.document.languageId`')

name: E07 updateCellContext: the text is read for every language
why: a getText of the active file at every cursor move and edit, whatever its language (the old inline test read the text only for a quarto document); the answers are unchanged, so only a pin can see it; killed by s342-typing-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name '`() => documentText(editor.document)`')

name: E08 updateCellContext: the missing editor is not checked first
why: no active editor reads a property of undefined (it does not compile either); killed by s342-typing-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'is not `editor !== undefined && isInCodeCell(...)`')

name: E09 isInCodeCell: the text is read before the language id is looked at
from: return languageId === "quarto" && findCellAtPosition(typeof text === "function" ? text() : text, line) !== null;
to: return findCellAtPosition(typeof text === "function" ? text() : text, line) !== null && languageId === "quarto";
why: the same answers, but a function text is called for every language; killed by the 'any other language id: the function is never called' row of in-code-cell.test.ts

name: E10 isInCodeCell: the language id is compared without regard to case
why: a document of language 'Quarto' or 'QUARTO' has the key; killed by the 'Quarto' and 'QUARTO' rows of in-code-cell.test.ts (VS Code language ids are lower case and compared as written)

name: E11 isInCodeCell: the line is rounded down
why: a fractional line just past a cell's closing fence (8.5 after line 8) is taken for the fence; killed by the fractional-line rows of in-code-cell.test.ts

name: E12 isInCodeCell: a function text is ignored
why: a function text reads as an empty document; killed by the function-text rows of in-code-cell.test.ts

name: K01 isVisible: the document handler is guarded the wrong way round
why: an edit in a visible document is not tinted, one in a hidden document is; isVisible is read by no behaviour test (the integration test refreshes through the test hook, which does not call it); killed by s342-typing-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'isVisible is not')

name: A01 filterOutOfCellEdits: a single edit is not checked
why: an item with ONE additional edit (the usual auto-import, anchored at the module top, which identity-maps into the front matter) keeps an out-of-cell edit; the integration row hands the filter TWO edits and does not notice; killed by s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'the edit guard of filterOutOfCellEdits')

name: A02 filterOutOfCellEdits: the filter's result is not assigned
why: `kept` is computed, then the unfiltered edits are kept: the guard is gone; probably also killed by test:integration (embedded.test.ts), which was not run; killed by s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'is not made from `kept` alone'); the A02 row there replaces the assignment by a regular expression, so that A05 is not scored as its kill

name: A03 filterOutOfCellEdits: the first item is not walked
from:
for (const item of list.items) {
    const edits = item.additionalTextEdits;
to:
for (const item of list.items.slice(1)) {
    const edits = item.additionalTextEdits;
why: the first completion item keeps its out-of-cell edits; the lens saw it killed, but only by the applicability check of the rows that quote the loop (their `from` no longer occurs), which is not a pin that names it; killed by s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'does not walk `list.items`')

name: A04 filterOutOfCellEdits: the list is rebuilt incomplete
why: the server's isIncomplete is lost (the list is always rebuilt incomplete, so the client asks again on every keystroke); no test reads isIncomplete of the filtered list; killed by s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'does not end by returning `new vscode.CompletionList(list.items, list.isIncomplete)`')

name: A05 filterOutOfCellEdits: an item with no kept edit keeps an empty list
why: EQUIVALENT for VS Code: an empty additionalTextEdits array and none are the same to the editor, so the pin is made from `kept` alone and not from its spelling; a row of s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts says the pin leaves it alone

name: FA format-cell: the filter's result is not applied
why: `kept` is computed and tested for emptiness, then the unfiltered edits are applied: the corruption guard is gone; probably also killed by test:integration (format-cell.test.ts), which was not run; killed by s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts: the live-file row fails (the same respelling is an EDITS row there that must name 'does not apply `wsEdit.set(editor.document.uri, kept)`')

name: FB format-cell: the emptiness test is on the unfiltered edits
why: EQUIVALENT in observable behaviour: after the early return on an empty or missing `edits`, `edits.length === 0` can never be true, so the guard never fires and an all-out-of-cell edit list applies an EMPTY WorkspaceEdit, a no-op (not run in a real host: applyEdit of an empty set is believed to change nothing); a row of s342-range-wiring-pin.test.ts says the pin leaves it alone
